statement: Broadcom and Marvell together control an estimated 95% of the custom AI ASIC co-design market, concentrating the custom-silicon supply chain in two vendors.
why: Extreme concentration of custom-ASIC co-design in two firms is a structural supply-chain dependency and bottleneck risk for the ASIC alternative.

impact.mechanism: With ~95% of ASIC co-design in two vendors, custom-silicon supply depends on limited capacity - a concentration risk that both enables and constrains the ASIC alternative to merchant GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: Broadcom and Marvell together control an estimated 95% of the custom AI ASIC co-design market.

confidence.basis: Secondary opinion/analysis (faf.ae); single publisher, capped at medium.
